description: Withdraw tokens from an agent vault back to your own wallet. The vault is yours, so this always works, with or without a live delegation, and the agent cannot block it. Leaves the allowance untouched: lowering the balance already limits what the agent can spend. Requires confirm:true to broadcast.

amount.description: Tokens to withdraw. Omit to withdraw the entire balance.

secret.description: Owner secret key for this call only.

name: withdraw_from_vault
title: Move funds out of an agent vault back to the owner
